protocol.comparability: Preserves400 sample exposures per fitted source-material pair; total optimizer updates and workpiece count both increase. Does not isolate workpiece count versus budget as a causal factor. One fitted seed and one source; no local-gradient, FWI, full-source or test claim.
protocol.motivation: Two fitted materials can now be distinguished in receivers, while interior differences remain poor. Check whether this extends beyond memorizing the fitted pair before adding architectural complexity.
